schema.purpose: Durable inventory of registered Remotion work, rendered training-video artifacts, and review evidence.
schema.compositionRecord: Each unique stable Remotion id appears once under compositionFamilies[].compositions. entrypointRefs preserves duplicate registration across roots.
schema.outputCoverage: Every regular file under output is represented either by one videoArtifacts record or as a member of one evidenceStillCollections record.
schema.evidenceCollectionRecord: Collection bytes, image spec, integrity digest, and statuses apply to every listed member; member names provide complete output-file coverage without duplicating low-value per-image metadata.

sourceStatus.registered: Registered source; this says nothing about review, approval, or whether a render exists.
sourceStatus.registered_example: Registered example, template, diagram, or generic parameterized composition.
sourceStatus.registered_proof_only: Registered specifically as a proof or experimental inspection surface.
sourceStatus.registered_incomplete: Registered, but evidence identifies missing inputs, provisional captures, or unfinished beats.

technicalReview.unreviewed: No explicit technical-review verdict was found.
technicalReview.changes: Evidence records a blocking technical defect or an unmet gate.

humanSignOff.pending: No human sign-off has been recorded.
humanSignOff.signed_off: A human explicitly approved this exact artifact.
humanSignOff.superseded: The artifact was overtaken by a later request or artifact.

deliverable.draft: Named or documented as a draft.
deliverable.candidate: A review/sign-off candidate, not a final.
deliverable.final: A deliverable whose exact bytes have human signed_off status.
deliverable.proof_only: Retained only as proof or diagnostic evidence.
deliverable.unclassified: There is not enough evidence to classify it further.

schema.humanAuthorityRule: Only a human may set humanSignOff to signed_off. Render success, validation, filenames, and automated or formal technical review are insufficient.
schema.finalInvariant: An artifact may be listed as deliverable=final only when the same record has humanSignOff=signed_off.

updateChecklist: Enumerate every registerRoot entrypoint and every Composition id; update entrypointRefs, dimensions, fps, frames, source paths, asset roots, docs, and counts.
Enumerate all regular files under output and ensure each appears in videoArtifacts or an evidenceStillCollections member list.
For each new or changed video, record exact relative path, byte size, SHA-256, ffprobe stream/container spec, composition id, and verified machine locations.
Record sourceStatus independently from technicalReview, humanSignOff, and deliverable status; cite the evidence for every non-default classification.
After technical review, set only technicalReview to approved or changes and add its evidence; do not change humanSignOff.
After explicit human review, record the named human decision and exact artifact hash. Set signed_off only from that decision; use final only with signed_off.
After replacement, rejection, publication, send, or cross-machine copy, update status/location/distribution facts without inferring approval.
Refresh lastVerifiedAt and counts, run all JSON/count checks, then reconcile the concise Markdown tables and signed-off-finals section against this file.
